csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using System.Text; using System.IO; using UnityEditor; public class Script { public static string Main() { var sb = new StringBuilder(); string assetPath = "Assets/Art/In-Game UI/Button - All.png"; var imp = AssetImporter.GetAtPath(assetPath) as TextureImporter; if (imp == null) return "ERROR: no importer"; bool wasReadable = imp.isReadable; imp.isReadable = true; imp.SaveAndReimport(); var tex = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Texture2D>(assetPath); int w = tex.width; int h = tex.height; sb.AppendLine("Size: " + w + "x" + h); var pixels = tex.GetPixels32(); int changed = 0; for (int i = 0; i < pixels.Length; i++) { var p = pixels[i]; if (p.a > 50 && p.r > 180 && p.g > 180 && p.b > 180) { pixels[i] = new Color32(p.r, p.g, p.b, 0); changed++; } } sb.AppendLine("Pixels made transparent: " + changed); tex.SetPixels32(pixels); tex.Apply(); byte[] png = tex.EncodeToPNG(); string fullPath = Path.GetFullPath(assetPath); File.WriteAllBytes(fullPath, png); imp.isReadable = wasReadable; imp.SaveAndReimport(); sb.AppendLine("Done. Button-All white areas are now transparent."); return sb.ToString(); } }
